Nadia: Quick sync: browser SDKs breaking when services switch to gRPC. Thinking per-request transport hint + tenant opt-in for safety. Need rollout + telemetry.

Ethan: Agreed. Header = X-RW-Transport: grpc|json. Honor only if tenant.flag('allow_transport_override') == true.

Nadia: Telemetry fields: route_chosen, override_allowed, override_used, fallback_code, token_cost_delta. Expose in Console request inspector.

Ethan: Canary plan: 1% global + tenant-targeted canaries. Console card shows routed_by (policy/override/fallback), latency sparkline, top fallback reasons. One-click rollback flips tenant flag.

Nadia: Edge note: json disables binary KV caching -> cost up. Console should show estimated cost delta pre-rollout.

Ethan: Implementation sketch (pseudo):
```
if tenant.flag('allow_transport_override') and header present:
  route = header
else:
  route = policy.default
emit span transport.selection {route, override_used, fallback_code}
```

clippy-bot: edge/route-v1 -> staging deployed :white_check_mark:

Nadia: I'll write the short RFC + mock for the Console card. Ethan: can you prototype the Envoy header match?

Ethan: Yup, I'll put up a PR with an envoy match rule and minimal tracing attrs.
